DJI.note: The article speaks of financial accessibility for all, not persons with disabilities.
A private-sector style payments app; no government service is stated as available online.

facts.fact: Djibouti Telecom's D-Money officially launched its new smartphone application on 26 September 2024, open to all Djiboutians since 21 September, for money transfers, bill payment and online purchases of services.

DJI.note: Bill payment is mentioned without naming any tax, duty or government fee.
